CustomField.description: BR-11/BR-12. Current SLA state, derived. Zero mutation - nothing writes this. Unmeasurable is deliberately distinct from Breached: an unmeasurable record is not a breached one (M-07). Excluded is decided from the routing OUTCOME recorded in Routing_Reason__c, not from Exception_Type__c: that field is a condition classification and its own description states that Non-Routing Intake does not mean the Lead reached the routing exception queue.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(SLA_Target_DateTime__c), IF( CONTAINS(Routing_Reason__c, "NIQ_Routing_Exception"), "Excluded", "Unmeasurable" ), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(First_Touch_DateTime__c)), IF( First_Touch_DateTime__c <= SLA_Target_DateTime__c, "Met", "Breached (Late Response)" ), IF( NOW() > SLA_Target_DateTime__c, "Breached", IF( NOW() > SLA_Target_DateTime__c - 0.041666667, "At Risk", "Pending" ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current SLA state. Derived - not editable by anyone.
CustomField.label: SLA Status
